reviewers.method: Initial independent form review of revision 6fb462ffc0ed. Inspected all 77 contact sheets (4 views x 8 phases; 16 for kb-getup) and native 480px frames where detail mattered (kb-upright-row, kb-clean, kb-getup, staggered-pushup, plank-jump-ins, climbers, punches, triceps-stretch). Read the clip JSON contracts and joint tracks with scratch scripts to check contralateral pairing, grip/contact positions, foot planting, elbow angles, torso rotation sign, and ranges; read geometry.json validator results. Real-time playback was not available, so timing and loop smoothness were inferred from duration and per-frame joints only. Primary sources opened: NHS Strength exercises (https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/exercise/strength-exercises/) for sit-to-stand, wall press-up, bicep curl and calf raise; ACE Bird-dog (https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/14/bird-dog/) for limb heights. Source IDs (S1-S59, K1-K7, H1-H3) are not resolvable to URLs in this repo, so chart-defined and IDs-only cues (e.g. S53 punches, S54 chops) were judged against the generator docstrings and general practice. The kb-pullover user reference video was not available. These are editorial AI judgments, not professional certification.

kb-swing.summary: Two-hand hip-hinge swing: backswing between the thighs, hip drive, float near chest height, return to hinge; both hands on the handle throughout. Reads as a swing, not a squat or front raise.

kb-deadlift.summary: Bell starts on the floor between the feet, two-hand grip, hinge to stand and back to a floor reset. Correct deadlift identity.

defects.issue: Setup has quite a lot of knee bend (squat-leaning hinge); still acceptable for a KB deadlift.
defects.fix: Optional: shift pelvis back ~40 mm and reduce knee flexion at the floor phase so the hinge reads more clearly.

goblet-squat.summary: Bell held at chest by both hands throughout; comfortable-depth squat with feet planted; stands fully. Matches the represented variant.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Goblet hold kept; steps back into a rear-knee-near-floor lunge, returns, then the other leg. Alternation shown, front foot stays planted.

kb-side-lunge.summary: Wide stance, sits back over one bent knee with the other leg long, returns, repeats the other side; bell stays at chest.

kb-upright-row.summary: Two-hand handle grip; bell lifted close to the body to lower chest, elbows lead and stay near shoulder height, controlled lower.

defects.issue: Elbows reach exactly shoulder height (elbow y 1375 mm vs shoulder 1381 mm); contract says elbows below shoulders.
defects.fix: Stop the pull ~40-60 mm lower so elbows remain visibly below the shoulders at the top.

kb-bent-row.summary: Staggered stance, right hand on front thigh, left arm rows bell from hang to hip with elbow driving back, flat-ish hinged torso. Clear one-arm row.

kb-side-bend.summary: Bell in the left hand, right hand on hip; trunk bends toward the bell and returns to tall. Identity clear from front/three-quarter.

kb-curl.summary: Horn-grip two-hand curl; elbows stay beside the ribs (elbow z ~10-60 mm) while the bell rises from thighs to chest and lowers slowly.

kb-halo.summary: Bell circles the head from front to side to behind (base down, elbows high) to other side and back, then reverses direction. Both directions shown; grip stays on the horns.

kb-clean.summary: Rack, drop into hinge backswing between the thighs, hip drive, elbow pulls in, bell lands on the outside of the forearm in the rack.

defects.issue: Racked bell sits in front of the sternum and hides the forearm, so the 'outside of the forearm' rack contact is hard to see.
defects.fix: Move the racked bell ~30-40 mm laterally/back toward the shoulder pocket so the forearm under it stays visible.

kb-press.summary: Single-arm strict press from rack to lockout beside the ear and controlled return; legs still.

defects.issue: Elbow flares wide (elbow x ~355-393 mm vs shoulder ~180 mm) during the press/lower, so the forearm is not vertical as the contract states.
defects.fix: Keep the elbow nearer the shoulder plane (x ~250 mm) with the forearm vertical under the bell through mid-press.

kb-snatch.summary: Lockout, drop into backswing, hip drive, high pull with elbow up, punch through to lockout with bell on the back of the forearm.

defects.issue: On the drop the bell casts far forward (wrist z ~420 mm at hip height), more like a swing than a close drop.
defects.fix: Keep the drop path closer to the body (pull the elbow in and let the bell fall near the torso) before it passes into the backswing.

kb-getup.summary: Full get-up and reverse: lie with bell pressed, roll to elbow, post hand, high bridge, sweep the leg into a half-kneel, windmill upright, lunge-stand, and reverse; bell arm stays vertical. Long 34 s cycle judged from 16 phases plus joint data only.

defects.issue: Posted right hand is mostly hidden behind the torso in captures, so the hand-post step is hard to verify from this view.
defects.fix: Rely on the app default camera that shows the posted hand side; no motion change required.

kb-pullover.summary: Standing horns-grip upside-down bell travels from chest over the head to behind the head with bent elbows and back. Matches contract; the 'user reference video' source could not be inspected.

squat.summary: Hips back and down to comfortable depth, feet flat, arms forward as counterbalance, stands tall. Clear bodyweight squat.

wall-pushup.summary: Palms on the wall at chest height, whole-body lean, elbows bend down and slightly out, presses away; feet planted. Matches NHS wall press-up.

defects.issue: Front camera sits behind the wall; the figure is fully hidden.
defects.fix: Use side/three-quarter as the default view (the app default is not front); no motion change needed.

calf-raise.summary: Toes stay grounded (toe y 0) while heels lift ~100 mm and lower; controlled. NHS also offers chair support, optional.

shoulder-circle.summary: Shoulders roll forward-up-back-down (backward roll) with arms hanging; ~50 mm circle. Correct direction; subtle in front view, readable from the side.

reverse-lunge.summary: Alternating rearward step with front foot planted, rear knee lowers, rise and return before switching.

pushup.summary: High plank, palms under shoulders, elbows bend ~35-40 degrees from torso, body line held, press up. Clear push-up.

wide-pushup.summary: Hands clearly wider than shoulders (palm x 370 mm); same descent and press. Distinct from the standard push-up.

close-pushup.summary: Hands narrow (palm x 70 mm), elbows track back by the sides. Distinct variant.

staggered-pushup.summary: Push-up with one hand forward, but the stagger is only 130 mm and hard to see from front/side.

defects.issue: Hand stagger (palm_l z 350 vs palm_r z 220) is too small to identify the variant at a glance.
defects.fix: Increase stagger to ~250-300 mm (one hand near forehead line, the other near lower ribs), keep elbows tracking.

stacked-pushup.summary: One foot stacked on the other (top toe 97 mm up) for the whole set; visible from front and three-quarter.

raised-leg-pushup.summary: Straight leg lifts during the push-up, alternating legs across the loop; palms and support forefoot grounded.

spiderman-pushup.summary: Knee draws out to the side toward the same-side elbow as the body lowers, presses back, alternates sides.

decline-pushup.summary: Feet on chair seat, palms on floor, lower and press. Chair support correct.

clapping-pushup.summary: Lower, explosive press, hands leave the floor and clap under the chest, land and reset.

defects.issue: Landing reaches straight-arm plank immediately (source/code note asks to land softly).
defects.fix: Land on slightly bent elbows and absorb ~60-80 mm before the reset.

power-pushup.summary: Same explosive press with hands leaving the floor but no clap; differentiated from the clapping variant.

defects.issue: Stiff straight-arm landing.
defects.fix: Land with soft elbows and absorb before resetting.

pike-pushup.summary: Inverted V with hips high; elbows bend from ~158 to ~96 degrees bringing the head toward the floor between the hands, then press.

standing-knee.summary: Alternating forward bent-knee lifts with stable support foot; both sides shown.

side-step.summary: True step-together: lead foot lifts and steps out, trailing foot follows, then reverse; only the swing foot leaves the floor.

defects.issue: Posture is a soft athletic crouch (knees ahead of ankles ~130 mm) rather than the upright sideways walk in NHS.
defects.fix: Straighten knees slightly (pelvis ~30-40 mm higher) for a more upright stance.

glute-bridge.summary: Supine bent knees, feet and upper back grounded, hips lift to a straight thigh-torso line and lower.

bird-dog.summary: Quadruped; opposite arm and leg extend to about parallel (ACE), return, switch diagonal. Contralateral confirmed in joint data.

plank.summary: Static forearm plank from toes, elbows under shoulders, straight line. Correct hold.

sit-ups.summary: Bent knees, hands behind head, trunk curls up to ~60 degrees and lowers with feet and pelvis grounded.

reverse-crunches.summary: Tabletop legs curl toward chest with pelvis lifting ~100 mm off the floor, then lower; back and arms grounded.

bicycle-crunches.summary: Shoulders held up, opposite elbow travels toward the knee drawn in, alternating sides.

defects.issue: Closest elbow-to-opposite-knee gap is still ~340 mm, and the non-working leg stays half-bent instead of extending.
defects.fix: Add more trunk rotation so the elbow comes within ~150 mm of the knee, and extend the other leg as the knee drives in.

flutter-kicks.summary: Supine, legs straight and low, small alternating up-down kicks.

leg-raises.summary: Straight legs lift from a hover to about 45 degrees and lower, back and arms on the floor.

superman.summary: Prone; arms and legs lift together, hold, lower. Hips and belly stay down.

back-lifts.summary: Prone chest lift with hands at the temples, legs and hips stay down. Distinct from superman.

alt-arm-leg-plank.summary: High plank; opposite arm and leg reach and return, switching sides; contralateral pairing confirmed.

shoulder-taps.summary: High plank; a hand lifts to tap the opposite shoulder, replaces, alternates. Clear identity.

climbers.summary: Alternating knee drives are present, but the legs scissor at floor level and the posture reads like crawling/kneeling rather than a plank.

defects.issue: Both knees pass ~20-55 mm above the floor at the switch, so the figure looks kneeling.
defects.fix: Keep knees >=150 mm off the floor during the switch by lifting the swing foot higher.

defects.issue: Driven knee stays low (~140 mm high) with the foot planted under the hip instead of driving toward the chest; a static hold breaks the running rhythm.
defects.fix: Drive the knee toward the chest (knee y ~300 mm, z ~+150 mm), and remove the hold so the switch is continuous.

plank-jump-ins.summary: Plank to jump-in to plank is recognisable, but the landed position looks like kneeling on all fours rather than a crouch.

defects.issue: Feet land ~73 cm behind the hands with knees ~60-90 mm above the floor, so the 'in' position reads as kneeling.
defects.fix: Land the feet ~20-30 cm behind the hands, pelvis higher (~550-650 mm), knees under the chest and well off the floor.

tricep-extensions.summary: Forearm plank presses up to a high plank by straightening the elbows, then lowers to the forearms; hands/feet planted.

pseudo-planche.summary: High plank shifts the shoulders ~190 mm forward of the hands, holds, returns. Lean is readable from the side.

tricep-dips.summary: Floor dip: hands behind, feet forward, hips up, elbows bend backward lowering ~100 mm, then press.

fly-steps.summary: Standing hinge with rear leg lifting behind and arms out, hold, return, switch legs. Matches the chart-defined variant.

side-leg-raises.summary: Standing lateral leg raise with planted support foot, alternating legs.

punches.summary: Jab with the lead (left) hand and cross with the rear (right) hand from a staggered stance, but the torso rotation is reversed and the hips stay square.

defects.issue: During the right cross the right shoulder rotates back (shoulder_r z -67 mm, shoulder_l +65 mm); the jab at 0.250 also rotates the lead shoulder back. That reverses the hip/shoulder turn that powers the punch.
defects.fix: Reverse the chest yaw sign: rotate the punching-side shoulder forward (cross: right shoulder +z ~60-80 mm), and pivot the rear heel and hips with the cross.

side-to-side-chops.summary: Arms straight ahead, hands together, level arc side to side with shoulders turning toward the hands and hips forward; matches the generator's S54 note.

chest-expansions.summary: Arms open wide at shoulder height, then cross in front, alternating which arm is on top.

chin-ups.summary: Underhand, narrow grip; dead hang to chin at bar level, controlled lower. Elbows travel forward, consistent with a chin-up.

pull-ups.summary: Overhand, wider grip; hang to chin at bar, elbows out and down, controlled lower. Distinguished from chin-ups by grip and width.

doorframe-rows.summary: Hands grip the frame uprights, body leans back on planted feet, then pulls the chest toward the frame and lowers.

sit-stand.summary: Seated, leans forward, stands without arm support on planted feet, sits down. Identity is clear; setup and tempo depart from the NHS cue.

defects.issue: Pelvis sits mid-seat (~190 mm behind the front edge); NHS says sit on the edge of the chair.
defects.fix: Move the seated pelvis forward to ~50-80 mm behind the seat front.

seated-knee.summary: Seated tall with pelvis on the seat; one bent knee lifts and lowers, then the other.

db-curl.summary: Upper arms stay at the sides while both dumbbells curl to near the shoulders (~127 degrees of flexion) and lower.

band-pull.summary: Arms ahead at shoulder height, band visibly fixed to both hands, arms open to the sides and return.

neck-flexion.summary: Chin drops toward the chest, holds, returns, shoulders still.

neck-extension.summary: Head tips back to look up, holds, returns. Large range but clear.

side-neck.summary: Ear tilts toward shoulder on each side with shoulders level, hold and return.

overhead-reach.summary: Arms sweep overhead and hold a tall reach, but the contract's interlaced fingers are not shown.

defects.issue: Palms stay ~160 mm apart at the top; hands never join or interlace.
defects.fix: Bring the palms together above the head (palm x ~0 mm) with an interlaced or clasped hand state through the hold.

triceps-stretch.summary: The left arm bends behind the head, but the helping hand never reaches the raised elbow, so the contract's assisted stretch is missing.

defects.issue: Right palm hangs above the head (y ~1950 mm), ~330 mm from the left elbow (y 1660 mm). The right arm arches overhead and does not touch the elbow.
defects.fix: Place the right palm on the left elbow (target ~[150,1665,-40]) with the right elbow bent in front of the face, and hold it there.

cross-body-shoulder.summary: Left arm drawn across the chest at shoulder height; the right hand supports it above the elbow, hold and release.

behind-back-clasp.summary: Hands joined behind the hips, arms straight and lifted back, chest open, return.

torso-extension.summary: Hands on hips, standing back-bend and return.

side-bend.summary: Overhead reach with lateral trunk bend to the opposite side, return, other side; hips level.

oblique-twist.summary: Hands at chest, elbows out; shoulders rotate ~45 degrees left then right while the hips stay square.

cat-cow.summary: Quadruped with only the head moving; the spine never rounds or arches, so cat and cow are not taught.

defects.issue: Chest and pelvis joints are identical in every frame (chest y 574 mm). Only the head drops and lifts, which reads as a nod, not cat-cow.
defects.fix: Raise the chest/upper back ~60-80 mm and tuck the pelvis in cat; drop the chest ~40-60 mm and tilt the pelvis in cow. If the rig lacks a mid-spine joint, add one so the back can curve.

quad-stretch.summary: Standing on one leg, the same-side hand holds the ankle with the knee pointing down beside the standing knee; free arm out for balance.

defects.issue: Validator flags hand/thigh interpenetration of -22 mm.
defects.fix: Move the grasping hand ~25 mm away from the thigh (outside of the ankle).

hamstring-stretch.summary: Front leg near-straight with heel down and toes up, hinge forward with the back knee bent and hands on the thigh, hold and return.

hip-flexor-lunge.summary: Half-kneeling with the back knee down; pelvis shifts forward ~120 mm with an upright torso, hold and return.

reclined-twist.summary: Supine with shoulders and arms flat; both knees roll to one side, return, then roll to the other.

reviewers.method: Inspected all 77 contact sheets (front/threequarter/left/right x 8 phases, 16 for kb-getup) from docs/animation-review/6fb462ffc0ed/sheets and opened ~30 native 480x480 frames for hands, grips, occlusion, framing and contacts. Read figure.ts, hand-model.ts, kettlebell-model.ts, equipment-model.ts, figure-viewer.tsx, design/visual-tokens.json and src/constants/theme.ts. Used geometry.json clearances and computed from each clip JSON: per-frame joint speed, one-frame spikes, loop-seam step/acceleration, floor penetration and pairwise differences between similar clips. Real-time playback was NOT available: timing, pacing and loop seam are judged from duration and per-frame joint data only; the app's default per-clip camera (clip 'view') was not captured, so views were judged as the four fixed captures; PSX mode not reviewed.

kb-swing.summary: Hinge, float to chest height and hike read clearly in left/right/threequarter; two-hand grip on the handle is legible. Fast 1.43 s loop is plausible for a swing.

defects.issue: At the hike the bell is hidden between/behind the near thigh and the forearms sink 16 mm into the thighs (geometry forearm_l/r vs thigh -0.016 m).
defects.fix: Carry the hike path 3-4 cm wider/higher between the thighs or open the knees slightly so forearms and bell clear the thigh hulls.

defects.issue: Iron bell #55534e is a dark low-contrast blob on the #0b0b0a stage at phone size.
defects.fix: Lift the iron colour a step (about #6a675f) or strengthen the rim light so the bell silhouette separates from the stage.

kb-deadlift.summary: Clear hinge with bell between the feet in every view; handle grip reads; floor contact at the bottom is visible.

defects.issue: Upper arms pass 16.5 mm into the thighs at the bottom (geometry upper_arm vs thigh -0.0165 m).
defects.fix: Hang the arms a little more vertical/inside the knees at the bottom, or narrow the upper-arm radius near the shoulder.

goblet-squat.summary: Bell held at the chest by the horns, squat reads well from all four views; clean silhouette.

defects.issue: At depth the bell and both forearms overlap the chest into one dark mass; elbows touch the thighs (-1 mm).
defects.fix: Hold the bell 2-3 cm further forward at depth so the elbow-to-knee gap stays visible.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Alternating step-back with goblet hold reads clearly in side and three-quarter views.

defects.issue: Front view hides the rear leg behind the front leg; lunge reads only as a dip.
defects.fix: Acceptable for front; consider default view az 60 (already set) and no change needed beyond the cross-cutting disc/shading items.

kb-clean.summary: Swing-to-rack path is readable from the sides; the rack position is muddy.

defects.issue: In the rack the bell covers the chest and the rack hand/forearm disappears behind it; the bell looks pasted on the shirt.
defects.fix: Seat the bell slightly outside the forearm (toward the lateral side) and keep the wrist/hand visible above the handle; or bias the default camera so the rack arm is near.

defects.issue: Forearm passes 14 mm into the thigh on the back-swing (geometry forearm_l vs thigh -0.0137).
defects.fix: Widen or raise the back-swing arc so the forearm clears the thigh.

kb-press.summary: Rack to lockout is clear in every view; bell stays on the handle grip and well framed.

defects.issue: Bell is far-side and sits near the top margin (about 40 px) at lockout; acceptable but tight.
defects.fix: Keep the current framing margin; no change required.

kb-snatch.summary: Hike, high pull and punch-through to overhead read from all views; motion speed is plausible.

defects.issue: Turnover phase compresses bell, hand and head into one cluster.
defects.fix: Hold the turnover a frame or two longer at the top so the transition is perceptible.

kb-halo.summary: Upper-body crop makes the circle large and clear in side views; front view loses the bell.

defects.issue: Bell is fully hidden behind the head when it passes behind; the front view shows only arms framing the face.
defects.fix: Offset the halo path slightly higher behind the head or prefer a three-quarter default; document that the front orbit hides the bell.

defects.issue: Bell passes in front of the face and covers it; the far arm crosses the face.
defects.fix: Raise the bell path a few cm at the near side so the face stays visible.

kb-pullover.summary: Bell lowered behind the head and returned overhead reads well in left/right; horns grip legible.

defects.issue: Bell disappears behind the head at the bottom of the pullover.
defects.fix: Inherent to the front view; keep default side-ish camera.

kb-curl.summary: Two-hand horns curl reads in side views; bottom position intersects the thighs.

defects.issue: Bell sinks 8.7 mm into both thighs at the bottom and upper arms clip the thighs (-8 mm at 0.4).
defects.fix: Start the curl with the bell 2 cm further forward of the thighs.

kb-upright-row.summary: Elbows-high pull is clear in front and side views; handle grip readable.

defects.issue: Both forearms and hands overlap the bell into one shape at the top.
defects.fix: Minor; keep the elbows a touch higher than the hands so the V of the forearms remains visible.

kb-bent-row.summary: Staggered hinge and row are clear in left/threequarter; other orbits lose the bell.

defects.issue: Bell is hidden behind the near leg in the front view and behind the legs in the right view.
defects.fix: Accept for side, but set the default camera on the rowing side (already az 64) and move the bell path a few cm outward of the knee.

defects.issue: Forearm 3.8 mm into the thigh at the bottom.
defects.fix: Hang the bell slightly outside the front thigh.

kb-getup.summary: Long 34 s sequence is legible with 16 phases; the bell stays vertical and tracked. Floor phases are small in the fixed frame.

defects.issue: Lying and sit-up phases occupy only the bottom third; top half empty because framing fits the standing pose.
defects.fix: Allow the camera to ease between two framings (floor segment vs standing segment) or aim lower during floor phases.

defects.issue: Post hand on the floor is hidden behind the torso, so the support contact is not visible.
defects.fix: Bias the default orbit toward the post-arm side for this clip or move the post hand slightly further out.

kb-side-bend.summary: Front and threequarter show the lateral bend with the hand on the hip clearly.

defects.issue: Bell is fully hidden behind the body; side views show almost no bend.
defects.fix: Expected for a frontal-plane move; keep default front view and accept, or note limitation.

defects.issue: Lateral bend is invisible in profile; looks like standing still.
defects.fix: No motion fix; consider limiting orbit range or adding a subtle bell sway forward-free.

kb-side-lunge.summary: Wide lateral lunge with goblet hold reads strongly in front and threequarter, alternating sides cleanly.

pushup.summary: Clean plank-to-chest descent, hands flat with mittens and thumbs readable.

defects.issue: Feet hang past the floor disc into the black stage; the toe contact is not grounded visually (the 0.95 m disc is centred on the world origin, not on the plank's support footprint).
defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

defects.issue: Horizontal clip framed by its largest dimension, so the figure fills only the middle third of the square; the upper half is empty.
defects.fix: In figure-viewer, fit distance from the projected height and width separately and aim at the bounds centre, so floor work fills more of the 1:1 frame.

wide-pushup.summary: Hand width difference is clear in front/threequarter; side views identical to push-up (inherent).

defects.issue: Feet hang past the floor disc into the black stage; the toe contact is not grounded visually (the 0.95 m disc is centred on the world origin, not on the plank's support footprint).
defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

close-pushup.summary: Elbows tucked are visible in front/threequarter.

defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

defects.issue: Elbows and forearms merge with the torso at the bottom.
defects.fix: Small outward flare of 2-3 cm or near/far shading per arm would separate them.

staggered-pushup.summary: Reads as a push-up; the stagger is too small to see at phone size.

defects.issue: Hand offset is about 11 cm (wrist_r 110 mm vs push-up) and is lost at native size; looks like a regular push-up.
defects.fix: Increase the stagger to ~25-30 cm (one hand at shoulder, one by the ribs) so the variant reads.

defects.issue: Feet hang past the floor disc into the black stage; the toe contact is not grounded visually (the 0.95 m disc is centred on the world origin, not on the plank's support footprint).
defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

stacked-pushup.summary: Push-up readable; the stacked foot is barely legible.

defects.issue: The stacked foot hides behind the support foot; only one shoe reads.
defects.fix: Stack with a visible cross (top shoe angled) and/or give the top leg the near-side colour.

defects.issue: Feet hang past the floor disc into the black stage; the toe contact is not grounded visually (the 0.95 m disc is centred on the world origin, not on the plank's support footprint).
defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

decline-pushup.summary: Chair and feet-on-seat are clear in side/threequarter views.

defects.issue: Chair sits off the floor disc; chair legs and feet appear to float over the void.
defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on clip bounds so chair and hands both sit on it.

defects.issue: Chair is behind the figure and the head/shoulders cover the legs.
defects.fix: Acceptable; keep default side camera.

pike-pushup.summary: Inverted-V silhouette is distinctive and reads from every side view; head descent visible.

defects.issue: Head is hidden under the shoulders in front view.
defects.fix: Inherent; no change.

clapping-pushup.summary: Push-off and flight read; the clap itself is a near-imperceptible moment.

defects.issue: Palms cross through each other by ~20 mm at the clap (palm_l x -10 mm, palm_r +10 mm) and the clap lasts about 2 frames.
defects.fix: Stop the palms at contact (x = +/-35 mm) and hold the clap 3-4 frames.

defects.issue: Except for 0.5 s of flight the clip is identical to power-pushup (max diff 173 mm, only in the airborne frames).
defects.fix: Raise the hands higher/longer and bring them together in front of the chest so the two clips differ at a glance.

defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

power-pushup.summary: Explosive press and brief hand lift visible; hard to tell apart from the clapping variant.

defects.issue: Airborne hands lift only ~0.33 m for ~0.4 s; otherwise identical to clapping-pushup.
defects.fix: Exaggerate the hand lift (higher, hands stay wide) and emphasise the catch to differentiate.

defects.fix: Centre the ground disc on the clip's support-polygon centre (mean of planted hand/foot contacts over the loop) or size it to the clip bounds in figure.ts.

raised-leg-pushup.summary: Leg raise alternates clearly, especially in threequarter and side views.

defects.issue: Feet hang past the floor disc into the black stage; the toe contact is not grounded visually (the 0.95 m disc is centred on the world origin, not on the plank's support footprint).

defects.fix: Match first/last frame velocity of the raised leg.

reviewers.method: Viewed all 77 contact sheets (4 views x 8 phases; 16 for kb-getup) and enlarged native 480x480 frames for push-up hands, wall push-up, goblet squat, kb-curl, kb-halo, kb-getup sweep, back-lifts/superman feet. Measured every clip's frames[].j with scripts: segment-length variation, knee-hinge axis vs foot transverse axis, shin-foot (ankle) angle, elbow/knee interior angles, trunk twist, floor penetration using drawn radii from figure.ts (hip 70, knee 54, elbow 34 mm; shoe sole at heel/toe joints; flat palm centred on wrist height), foot/hand contact drift, grip-point vs wrist/palm and bar centreline, capsule self-collision (arms vs torso/legs/head, leg vs leg), bell clearance, prop penetration (slabs/tubes), and single-frame joint pops (second difference). Used geometry.json and clip validator for collisions/ZMP. Not observed: real-time playback (timing judged from duration and per-sample joint steps only); the shirt hull was approximated as a capsule; ZMP was not recomputed independently.

kb-swing.summary: Credible hinge swing: knees 143 deg min, hips 86 deg flexion, two-hand grip exactly on the handle in every frame, bell passes between thighs with 5 mm clearance. Forearms brush the inner thighs (-16 mm) on the hike, which is normal contact.

kb-deadlift.summary: Hinge with neutral spine, bell base touches the floor (3 mm) at the bottom and grips stay on the handle. Upper arms press 16 mm into the thighs at the bottom; reads as contact, not impossible.

goblet-squat.summary: Horn grip held at the chest through a 69 deg knee / 108 deg hip squat; heels planted, knees track the toes. Forearms overlap the bell body by up to 14 mm (drawn radii), a small visual merge.

defects.issue: Bell body intersects both forearms by ~14 mm (drawn radii).
defects.fix: Move the bell centre 15 mm forward of the chest or spread the horn grip slightly.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Clean alternating lunge with constant segments and goblet hold. The stepping foot skims 4-11 mm above the floor while moving 15-18 mm per sample at lift-off and touch-down (phases 0.07-0.17, 0.45, mirrored), reading as a slight drag.

defects.issue: Stepping foot moves horizontally while still within 11 mm of the floor (drag rather than lift).
defects.fix: Lift the swing foot to >=25 mm clearance before translating it; translate only after lift-off.

defects.issue: Bell overlaps forearms by ~15 mm.
defects.fix: Same bell/forearm offset as goblet squat.

kb-side-lunge.summary: Lateral lunge with 54 deg hip abduction, knee over toes, trailing leg straight, feet planted. Bell/forearm overlap of 18 mm is the only geometric blemish.

defects.issue: Bell intersects forearms ~18 mm.
defects.fix: Offset bell centre forward ~20 mm.

kb-upright-row.summary: Elbows rise to shoulder height with the handle held two-handed; bell grazes the torso hull (-5 mm) at the top, otherwise clear. Wrist sits 75 mm below the handle so the palm stretches slightly but stays attached.

kb-bent-row.summary: Staggered-stance one-arm row: grip on handle every frame, free hand rests on the front thigh (0 mm contact), hips hinge 94 deg, feet planted. Resting hand is a relaxed mitten, not a palm-on-thigh pose (cosmetic).

kb-side-bend.summary: Lateral bend with bell at the side and other hand on the hip; segments constant. The trunk is a single rigid pelvis-chest segment, so the bend pivots at the hips rather than curving through the spine; acceptable for this rig.

kb-curl.summary: Elbow flexes to 48 deg with upper arm fixed at the side; two-hand handle grip constant; bell clears thighs (2 mm) at the bottom.

kb-halo.summary: Bell held upside-down by the horns circles the head; grips stay on the horns, bell keeps 49 mm from the head and 11 mm from the forearms. Biacromial width varies 27 mm (scapular protraction/retraction), plausible. Bell orbits at neck/shoulder height on the sides, so the near forearm crosses the chin at 0.125/0.625.

kb-clean.summary: Hike, hip drive and rack are anatomically consistent; bell lands on the back of the forearm with 6 mm clearance; feet planted. Rack elbow interior angle 26 deg is at the edge of the soft-tissue limit.

kb-press.summary: Rack to lockout press with constant segments, bell resting on forearm (6 mm). Rack elbow interior angle 22 deg is tighter than real soft-tissue contact allows (~30-35 deg), so forearm and upper-arm tubes overlap in the rack.

defects.issue: Rack elbow folded to 22 deg; forearm and upper-arm tubes visibly merge.
defects.fix: Open the rack elbow to ~32 deg (wrist slightly forward of the shoulder).

kb-snatch.summary: Swing-to-overhead path with correct hinge, punch-through and lockout; bell clears head by 165 mm and rests on forearm overhead (4 mm). Fast elbow travel (139 mm/sample) occurs only in the ballistic phase.

kb-getup.summary: Most of the 34 s sequence is credible, but both leg-sweep transitions are geometrically wrong: with the right knee on the floor, the right shin folds up into the air (ankle 431 mm high, above the hip at 389 mm), the knee hinge is twisted ~135 deg relative to the foot (ankle/tibia rotation impossible), the ankle is dorsiflexed to a 20 deg shin-foot angle, and the folded shin passes 65 mm into the pelvis/torso. The right toe also drags 900 mm along the floor across the sweep.

defects.issue: Kneeling leg: shin flips upward behind the body, foot points upward, knee hinge rotated ~135 deg against the foot; shin intersects the torso by 65 mm.
defects.fix: Author the sweep as: shin slides back along the floor (ankle y<=90 mm, instep down) with the foot following tibial rotation; keep knee hinge axis within 30 deg of the foot's transverse axis.

defects.issue: Shin-foot angle 20 deg (extreme dorsiflexion).
defects.fix: Clamp ankle to shin-foot angle >= 70 deg (or >= 160 deg plantarflexed when the instep is on the floor).

defects.issue: Right toe drags ~0.9 m while within 12 mm of the floor.
defects.fix: Pin the toe during kneel-down and lift it before repositioning.

kb-pullover.summary: Standing overhead pullover with two-hand grip; bell clears head by 47 mm and shoulders flex fully without elbow collapse.

defects.issue: No lateral weight shift onto the supporting hand/foot diagonal; ZMP 0.144 m outside support.
